preprocessing: Year standardized on training rows; binary indicators retain 0/1 units; steel reference material fixed from domain; location dictionary learned in each training split; unknown levels ignored.
group_validation: GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=320); identical assignment for all models and both endpoints.
time_validation: Incident years 2010-2021 train, 2022-2024 test. Operator overlap allowed and reported.
analysis_unit: Unique incident report; operator is bootstrap and grouped-validation unit.
intervals: Wilson 95% is an independent-report reference; differences use 2000 paired operator resamples and percentile 2.5/97.5%; no p values.
causal_scope: Associations conditional on being a reported incident; no monthly pipeline exposure denominator and no nonincident pipe controls.
